commit_message:
feat(benchmark): implement memory and concurrency benchmarks

Add comprehensive benchmarks for measuring:
- Memory per connection at rest (1, 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000 connections)
- Concurrent throughput with latency percentiles
- Memory growth patterns over time
- GC impact under load
- Connection scaling behavior
- Memory footprint for idle connections

Metrics include:
- Per-connection memory footprint
- Requests per second
- Latency percentiles (p50, p95, p99)
- GC cycles and pause times
- Heap and system memory usage
- Goroutine counts

Benchmarks are runnable via:
go test -bench=Memory -benchmem ./benches/...
go test -bench=Concurrent -benchmem ./benches/...
go test -bench=GC -benchmem ./benches/...
go test -bench=Scaling -benchmem ./benches/...
